timeline_management_policy.purpose: Tell customers whether their requested date can be met before accepting an order, then keep them updated.
timeline_management_policy.business_days_definition: Configure by actual workshop working calendar, local holidays and capacity.
timeline_management_policy.estimate_formula: earliest_ship_date = agreed_production_start + scheduled_production_working_days + planned_approval_wait + rework_or_sourcing_buffer; estimated_delivery = earliest_ship_date + courier_estimate + transport_buffer.
timeline_management_policy.requested_date_rule: Capture requested IN-HAND date, not just shipping date. Never automatically promise the requested date.
timeline_management_policy.promise_date_rule: Only display a committed date after workshop confirms capacity, required inputs, design approvals, payment conditions and delivery postcode.
timeline_management_policy.customer_approval_delay: If approvals or materials arrive late, recalculate delivery date and obtain acknowledgement rather than silently changing it.
timeline_management_policy.scope_change_rule: After approval, provide an updated quote and delivery estimate before accepting any material change.
timeline_management_policy.delay_escalation: Notify customer as soon as a likely delay is identified, explaining cause, new window and options.
timeline_management_policy.reminder_rule: Send approval reminders only on the frequency the customer agreed to.

example_only.note: Illustrative dates only; calculate with actual business calendar and courier cutoff, then confirm feasibility before committing.
